messages:
julian_cs: Hey team — Nexus Logistics (acct: NEX-113) uploaded a resale certificate via their accountant (Ardent CPA). Billing has blocked invoice INV-2026-334 for reverse-charge pending. They claim VAT ID XI999999973 but VIES is failing. They also uploaded a signed delegation from the company to Ardent CPA. cc @oliver_billing

maria_support: thanks julian. can you paste the invoice id and the uploaded filenames? i'll pull the evidence.

julian_cs: INV-2026-334; files: nexus_resale_cert_2026.pdf, ardent_signed_delegation.pdf, gov-extract.pdf. customer says delegation authorizes Ardent CPA to act on their behalf for tax matters.

oliver_billing: VIES lookup returned NO_MATCH / timeout on GB/XI namespace. sometimes delegation + company naming differences cause this. we need: 1) government VAT registration or company extract showing VAT id 2) evidence the invoice payee matches the legal entity on the VAT doc. do we have the company reg number?

julian_cs: gov-extract.pdf shows company number 09876543 and trading name 'Nexus Logistics Ltd'. The uploaded VAT doc uses prefix XI (NI). Their invoice is addressed to 'Nexus Logistics Ireland Ltd' — looks like a subsidiary mismatch.

vat_verification_bot: automated check: VIES query for XI999999973 -> timed out. Cross-check with Companies House / NI registry -> no exact match found for VAT id. Recommend flag 'manual-vat-check' and attach gov docs.

maria_support: tagging billing-team for manual review. @oliver_billing can you confirm if we accept delegated-agent packets and what exact docs are required to unblock?

oliver_billing: policy summary: for delegated agents we accept signed delegation + government VAT registration or company extract with matching company number and registrant name. invoice must be addressed to the legal entity that holds the VAT id. if payee != registrant, reverse-charge may not be valid. manual override possible but requires 2 approvers and audit.

dan_engineering: FYI our billing UI raises code VAT_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH and auto-blocks capture. we can set billing.override_vat = true for a single invoice via internal admin API (requires billing approval + eng sign-off). i can run the override if you confirm. sample API: 
```
POST /internal/billing/invoices/INV-2026-334/override
{ "reason": "manual verification - docs attached", "approvals": ["oliver_billing"] }
```

maria_support: customer asks for ETA — can we do manual override today? invoice is overdue and customer is pushing.

oliver_billing: i'll review the docs now. if gov-extract shows entity matches VAT id and delegation looks genuine, i can approve override. i need the uploaded pdfs in the admin ticket, please.

julian_cs: uploaded secure link: https://files.redwood.com/s/secure/nexus-2667 (password shared with customer).

oliver_billing: confirmed receipt. quick read: gov-extract lists 'Nexus Logistics Ltd' company #09876543 with VAT record labeled XI999999973. invoice payee = 'Nexus Logistics Ireland Ltd' (different legal name). need explicit confirmation from customer that the Ireland entity is the VAT-registered party for that VAT id OR they must reissue invoice to the matching entity.

julian_cs: Customer confirms the accounting team made an error — they will reissue the invoice to 'Nexus Logistics Ltd' and re-upload. ETA 48 hours.

maria_support: ok marking thread waiting_on_customer. julian please set a 48h reminder. if they don't reissue, escalate to refunds/billing for hold or credit.

oliver_billing: internal note: billing.override_candidate = true; will not process capture until reissued invoice or explicit manual approval provided by me + one more approver. record in ticket BILL-789.

dan_engineering: added audit note to INV-2026-334: 'awaiting reissued invoice or manual_override per BILL-789'.

maria_support: thanks all — i'll close the loop once customer uploads the corrected invoice. :thumbsup:
